answer:
The father of the originator of cybernetics (Norbert Wiener) is **Leo Wiener**.

Leo Wiener was a Slavic language teacher, mathematician, and Harvard professor who played an instrumental role in nurturing his son's extraordinary talents. He homeschooled young Norbert Wiener from an early age, focusing heavily on mathematics and fostering his intellectual curiosity. This early support helped develop Norbert Wiener into a mathematical genius who would eventually graduate with a bachelor's degree in mathematics at age 14 and go on to coin the term "cybernetics" in his 1948 book *Cybernetics: Or Control and Communication in the Animal and the Machine*.
